root_cause: The live personal LinkedIn founder-journey behavior had advanced beyond repository source, while the repository candidate lacked canonical delivery metadata, a classified Brain regression path, and the three repository closure artifacts required for material Supabase changes. That combination could leave proven live behavior insufficiently protected by GitHub SSOT and regressions.
prevention: Persist the proven personal LinkedIn founder-journey runtime in repository source and migration history instead of leaving behavior live-only.
Keep the regression under the canonical tests/brain-* backend namespace so delivery classification remains explicit and fail-closed.
Require machine delivery metadata and writer lease to identify one obligation, one candidate and one exact head SHA.
Require Brain learning, human change documentation and development-ledger evidence for every material Supabase delta.
Preserve one personal LinkedIn chapter per day, Tuesday and Friday in English and the other days in Dutch, without duplicate translations.
Keep forecasts probabilistic and evidence-bound: external signal to company impact to priority to action to measured outcome.

current: The orchestrator consumes recent_personal_chapters and predictive_forecasts for the personal founder journey.
The prompt explicitly forbids presenting forecasts as facts.
The personal language contract reads verified_personal_source.evidence.intended_language and forbids two languages in one personal LinkedIn post.
